title: A duplicated matrix has no tie to the matrix it came from
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, Default 40% margin in every range.
  • Have a copy of matrix A made with Duplicate for this test (matrix A (copy)).
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type 45 in Default's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Open matrix A (copy) from the Matrices list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • Default's first range reads 45.

Step 5:

  • Matrix A saves.

Step 6:

  • The copy's Default first range still reads 40% margin, not 45.
